data.title: Stop, or keep checking?
data.subtitle: Every round uses your limits. Know your exits before you start.

left.label: STOP HERE
items: Every test on the finish line passes
A new round finds nothing new
It needs a fact only you have
Two or three rounds on the same problem
The fix would change the brief, not the draft
It's a rough draft only you will read

right.label: KEEP GOING
items: A test is still partly or fail
An unverified claim carries the point
It says done, but items are still open
It offers to continue instead of continuing
A fix added a new claim with no source
You couldn't explain the answer to your boss
